description:
What is This Part?
If you are using an electric fuel pump then don’t waste HP on the old pump.
Replace it with this Cover!
This is the Fuel Pump Cover that goes over the Fuel Pump opening on the Engine.
Comes with the 2 Attachment Nuts
Comes with Gasket
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cover
Qty 1 – Gasket
Qty 2 – Attachment Nuts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
